bibl.title: "Il vanto sirenico". Pindaro, fr. 94b, 13-20 M.
bibl.seg: Tiziano Presutti, "Il vanto sirenico". Pindaro, fr. 94b, 13-20 M.
bibl.note: P. Oxy. IV, 659 = P. lit. Lond. 44 (= MP3 1371; LDAB 3742). - Discusses a passage of Pindarus' Daphnephoric Ode to Agasicles where the Sirens' song, imitated by the chorus, is able to calm down the stormy motion of the winds. Offers a new philological reading of the most disputed lines (ll. 19-20).
